clues.text: Through Jeremiah, God said Israel chasing the Baals was like a swift young female of this animal galloping here and there.
John the Baptist preached in the wilderness wearing a garment made from this animal's hair, with a leather belt.
Jesus told the scribes and Pharisees that they strain out a gnat but swallow this.
When Rebekah looked up and saw Isaac, she got down from riding this animal.
Rachel hid her father Laban's household idols in this animal's saddlebag and sat on them while he searched.
In the food laws given to Moses, this animal chews the cud but lacks a divided hoof, so it is unclean.
Hazael went to meet Elisha with forty loads of Damascus's best goods, each load carried by one of these.
